name: Mamori Hoken
description: Mamori Hoken — an independent insurance agency theme laid out like an app: under a formal top header, a night-ink sidebar holds the synced office board (advisers in today, hours, claims line, reply time, closed days and a Book a consultation button) and stays beside the page while it scrolls. The header splits the menu around the centred agency name, with the Book a consultation button at its end. Hanada (#2792C3), the clear indigo-washed blue of traditional Japanese dyeing, is the main colour: the hero, the story band and every page head are hanada fields set in night ink, textured with a faint linen texture. The hero is text left, art right: the title, lead, buttons and this month's questions on the field, a framed photograph of a young family on a sofa on the right, and a cut-out document folder with pen and glasses (transparent WebP) that breaks out over the frame and the hero bottom edge; a cut-out house model breaks over the story band and every page head. Every picture is a realistic, neutral photograph. LINE Seed JP for display, Public Sans for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: None: built exactly to design-plan.json row b5-1 (sidebar-app, text-left-art-right hero, split nav, pattern-texture, real-photography, hanada #2792C3, LINE Seed JP + Public Sans, business-services). A formal top header with the agency name centred between the menu and the Book a consultation button; the sidebar holds the synced office board. Pattern texture: a faint linen texture covers every hanada field and the ink sidebar. Break-frame: the cut-out document folder breaks out over the framed hero photo and the hero bottom edge, and the cut-out house over the story band and page heads.

summary.zh-TW: 縹色的獨立保險經紀：側欄顯示辦公室現況、左文右圖主視覺（全家人坐在沙發上的照片）、文件夾去背破框而出、淡淡的亞麻紋底紋，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A hanada blue insurance agency: a sidebar office board, text-left hero with a family photo, a cut-out document folder breaking the frame.
summary.ja: 縹色の独立系保険代理店。事務所のようすを示すサイドバー、左に文字・右に家族の写真、枠を越える書類ファイルの切り抜き、うっすらリネン調の地紋。
summary.fr: Un cabinet d’assurance bleu hanada : tableau du bureau en barre latérale, hero texte à gauche et photo de famille, chemise de documents détourée.
summary.de: Ein Versicherungsbüro in Hanada-Blau: Bürotafel in der Seitenleiste, Hero mit Familienfoto, freigestellte Dokumentenmappe.
